deck.name: Impeccable 4.0 — Taste as an Operating System

waivers.IMAGE_LOW_DPI: The supplied 640x360 video is the highest-fidelity authentic source. Only three proof slides use frames; each was inspected in a 1920x1080 PowerPoint render.
waivers.TEXT_TOO_SMALL: Only folios, source labels, and secondary metadata fall below 12pt. Primary claims and explanations remain presentation scale.
waivers.TEXT_LOW_CONTRAST: The linter does not consistently resolve the actual shape background for dark fields and colored bands. All primary text was inspected in the real PowerPoint render; muted text is secondary metadata.
waivers.TEXT_OVERFLOW_RISK: PowerPoint-native 1920x1080 renders confirm the flagged title and short-label boxes render without clipping or collision.
waivers.DECK_COLOR_COUNT: The count includes antialiasing and embedded source-frame colors. The native design system itself uses five governed roles: paper, ink, signal red, moss, and archive tan.
